The petitioner has prayed for the following reliefs:
(i) for issuance of a writ in the nature of Mandamus commanding and directing the respondents authority for payment of actual compensation amount to the petitioner after revaluation in lieu of Land (Commercial Land) acquired for the Patna High Court CWJC No.1776 of 2024(2) dt.14-05-2024 purpose of construction of National Highway-41 for Rajauli-  Bakhatyarpur Four Lane Road  Project, as per Right to Fair Ramdeo Prasad Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15612547/
1 Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2014 (hereinafter to be referred as 'the Act'), the said land situated at Mauza- Sikandar Kala, Thana No. 355, Khata no. 44, Khesra No. 251 total Rakawa-0.0222 acre and nature of the land is commercial;
(ii) for issuance of an appropriate writ directing and commanding the Respondents to stop the work of construction over the said land till payment of compensation to the petitioner;
(iii) for issuance of any other writ/ writs,order/orders,direction/direction for which the petitioner found entitled to.
